params.name: id
params.description: PID of the bibliographic entity. Must be prefixed with identifier type: doi:, pmid:, or omid:

params.name: require
params.description: Removes rows with empty values in the specified field

params.name: filter
params.description: Applies conditional filtering. Supports regex or operators (=, <, >). Format: field:operator:value. Example: date:>2015

params.name: sort
params.description: Orders results by field in ascending or descending order. Format: asc(field) or desc(field).

params.name: json
params.description: Transforms JSON data structure. Supports array splitting or dict conversion.

items.docs:
Retrieves citation data for all outgoing references to other cited works appearing in the reference list of the bibliographic entity identified by the input PID (DOI, PMID, or OMID).
Fields returned: oci, citing, cited, creation, timespan, journal_sc, author_sc.
